attackers_goals: The attacker may be attempting lateral movement within a compromised network.
description: An unusual NTLM authentication attempt by a user to a host. This may indicate the use of stolen credentials or access tokens to access restricted hosts.
investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication for the user account referenced by the alert, as this could indicate the attacker has used stolen credentials.
name: Rare NTLM Access By User To Host
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
